info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Search Configurations API
Retrieves the Global Search Configuration for the Organization

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

params.name: trackingId
params.description: The unique identifier of the tracking target.

items.docs:
Shows the global GlobalSearch configuration. Does not accept pin rules. in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"MERCHANDISING_HUB","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

info.name: Update the Global Search Configuration for the Organization

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

items.docs:
Updates the global Search configuration to be applied for the whole organization in a [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - Edit

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"MERCHANDISING_HUB","type":"EDIT","targetId":"{body.trackingId}"} ```
